UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$base='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; $nested=Join-Path $base 'server_distribution'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $nested) { Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $nested '*') -Destination $base -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $nested -Recurse -Force }; $assets=Join-Path $base 'assets'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $assets | Out-Null; $exe=Join-Path $base 'win\starbound_server.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { throw ('OpenStarbound Windows layout normalization did not produce expected server executable: ' + $exe) }"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$src=Join-Path '{{$FullRootDir}}' '211820\assets\packed.pak'; $dstDir=Join-Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}' 'assets'; $dst=Join-Path $dstDir 'packed.pak'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $src -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('Starbound packed.pak was not downloaded. Expected source: ' + $src + '. Verify AMP Steam credentials own Starbound (App 211820) and rerun Update.') }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dstDir | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination $dst -Force; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dst -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('Failed to install packed.pak at destination: ' + $dst) }; Write-Host ('Installed packed.pak: ' + $src + ' -> ' + $dst)"

-c "src='{{$FullRootDir}}211820/assets/packed.pak'; dst_dir='{{$FullBaseDir}}assets'; dst=\"$dst_dir/packed.pak\"; if [ ! -f \"$src\" ]; then echo \"Starbound packed.pak was not downloaded. Expected source: $src. Verify AMP Steam credentials own Starbound (App 211820) and rerun Update.\" >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p \"$dst_dir\"; cp -f \"$src\" \"$dst\"; test -f \"$dst\" || { echo \"Failed to install packed.pak at destination: $dst\" >&2; exit 1; }; echo \"Installed packed.pak: $src -> $dst\""

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dst=Join-Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}' 'storage\starbound_server.config'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dst -PathType Leaf)) { $b=''; [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($dst,[Convert]::FromBase64String($b)); Write-Host ('Installed default server config: ' + $dst) } else { Write-Host ('Preserving existing server config: ' + $dst) }"

-c "dst='{{$FullBaseDir}}storage/starbound_server.config'; if [ ! -f \"$dst\" ]; then printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > \"$dst\"; echo \"Installed default server config: $dst\"; else echo \"Preserving existing server config: $dst\"; fi"
-c "cd openstarbound/server && rm -f win >/dev/null 2>&1; ln -sf linux win >/dev/null 2>&1"
